narrator.description: A deep, warm, middle-aged male storyteller with a calm, cinematic narration style

ali.description: An energetic young man with a bright, slightly high, cheerful cartoon voice, quick and playful

ahmed.description: A deep-voiced, gruff older man with a low, slow, grumpy baritone voice

lines.text: Ali found a strange box in the garden.
Ahmed! Come and look at this!
A treasure box! I think it is full of gold.
Ali opened the box very slowly.
